about.title: About bersama.io
about.whatWeAreText: bersama.io is an independently run, unofficial supporter platform that brings together news, the agenda, and positions related to Parti Bersama Malaysia in one place. We believe in transparent, easy-to-understand information that every citizen can access. This platform is built by supporters, for supporters — free and bold.
about.disclaimerBox: Important: bersama.io is an UNOFFICIAL supporter platform. We are not affiliated with, operated by, or representative of Parti Bersama Malaysia. All content reflects our own independent editorial judgment.

rafizi.name: Rafizi Ramli
rafizi.bio: Rafizi Ramli is a Malaysian politician who leads Parti Bersama Malaysia. He is known for his advocacy of transparency, accountability, and reform of public institutions, as well as a data-driven approach to shaping policy.

nikNazmi.name: Nik Nazmi Nik Ahmad
nikNazmi.bio: Nik Nazmi Nik Ahmad is an experienced Malaysian politician contributing to the leadership of Parti Bersama Malaysia, with a focus on environmental issues, good governance, and policy reform.
